content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated gateway errors detected in us-west-2 ingress — spike in 502/504s. Incident token: IN-2026-0317-3276543210
sara: I’m on pager. digging into traces now, @lee can you pull ingress proxy logs for the last 15m?
lee: grabbing logs -> s3://redwood-logs/ingress/2026/03/17/3276543210.tar.gz :thumbsup:
sara: quick note: seeing a lot of upstream timeouts from runtime pool (conn reset / read timeout). example corr_id=6f2a3b
maria: adding timeline: spike begins ~14:03 UTC, peak ~14:09, partial recovery ~14:17
ben: will try a live mitigation: disable proxy retries to avoid retry amplification, rolling change now
sara: good. can we also route a fraction of traffic to eu-central as temporary headroom?
lee: routing policy change started (canary 10% -> 50%), ETA ~3m
ops-bot: runbook step applied: disable_ingress_retries=true
maria: hypothesis: overloaded runtime nodes -> connection resets -> gateway sees 504s -> retries amplify load. Need full KV/traces for corr_id 6f2a3b
sara: @lee paste trace/log snippet for corr_id 6f2a3b
lee: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-17T14:05:21Z","corr_id":"6f2a3b","upstream":"runtime-78","resp_code":504,"error":"read timeout","lat_ms":3020}
```
ben: scaling up runtime pool + adding 4 nodes as immediate headroom, will monitor
sara: customer impact estimate: ~1.2k failed requests between 14:05-14:12, mostly concentrated on a single heavy customer key. CS notified.
maria: saving timeline + artifacts to /internal/incidents/3276543210/artifacts/pack.zip
lee: pulling full trace bundle (kvlogs + proxy logs), will attach when ready
ben: routing canary bumped to 50% eu-central, no regression seen so far
ops-bot: mitigation status: retry_throttle=on, routing_shift=+eu-central(50%)
maria: error rate returning to baseline by 14:18, continuing verification for 10m window
sara: notes for RCA: check connection pool saturation on runtime-78, proxy keepalive/reuse config, and upstream retry policy defaults
lee: uploaded logs: https://internal.company/incident/3276543210/logs.tar.gz (access: eng-team)
ben: if scaling or routing causes issues we have rollback plan prepared (scale down + revert routing), tracking here
maria: collecting traces, will produce a short timeline doc with hypotheses and signal graphs
sara: next steps assigned: lee -> full logs & traces, ben -> routing + scaling follow-up, maria -> timeline + post-incident writeup. I'll open the incident doc and link artifacts.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, started=2026-03-17T14:03:00Z, mitigated=2026-03-17T14:18:00Z
sara: closing pager; keep this thread for RCA artifacts and postmortem comments. Thanks all. :pray:
